# Standalone bundled native library notice

`duckdb-1.5.6.LICENSE` is the upstream notice from [DuckDB v1.5.6](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/v1.5.6/LICENSE). Packaging copies the notice matching the locked native version beside the bundled `libduckdb.so`; a native-library upgrade must supply the corresponding notice.

The application and its Rust/JavaScript dependencies retain their respective upstream licenses. These files record the explicitly bundled shared-library notice, not a legal compliance audit or publisher attestation.
